changes: A real main-area Keyboard Shortcuts widget with standard command, cmd/ctrl+k cmd/ctrl+s, settings/menu contributions, command/shortcut search, source filtering, pagination, edit/add/remove/reset, chord recording and same-key conflict notices.

Targeted JSONC field/array edits preserve header and internal comments, unrelated entries, unknown properties, args and framework context. Runtime hot reload and negative default removal remain the same service.

Graphical changes refuse unsaved real JSON editor drafts, stale on-disk snapshots, malformed JSONC and invalid/modifier-only keys. Existing FileService conditional write metadata is used; no claim of a new atomic filesystem compare-and-swap protocol.
Only the owned shortcut entry input bypasses the framework global capture dispatcher, allowing chord recording. All other workbench/editor shortcuts retain original dispatch.
Unassigned private extension RPC commands do not clutter the default list; registered commands remain accessible by exact @command lookup. No new runtime dependencies or downloads.

checks: Graphical edit replaces one F2 default with F8, explicit Remove handles a separate extension F2 condition, and JSONC comments/arguments remain; F2 is removed and F8 opens real Rename.
Reset removes the user override and removal entry and restores the actual F2 default, retaining unrelated shortcuts.
Recording a two-stroke cmd+k cmd+y chord adds an actual Quick Open shortcut without firing the global command while recording.
A configuration change on disk while the edit dialog is open refuses the stale save and preserves the exact external bytes.
An unsaved real JSON editor draft blocks graphical writes and preserves both the disk configuration and draft.
Malformed saved JSON disables graphical mutation, retains its exact bytes and keeps the last valid runtime keymap active.

Recorded shortcuts persist and execute after real Reload Window; source filtering and standard cmd+k cmd+s work; unassigned private commands are hidden by default but remain available through exact command lookup.

jsoncEditTests.coverage: Preserves internal/unrelated comments and custom fields/args; default context/removal/reset; malformed/oversized/invalid-key refusal.

Normal JSON shortcuts command creates the own profile file; saved JSONC comments/trailing commas hot-apply F6 with editorTextFocus and invoke the real debug selection command.
A saved VS Code style cmd+k cmd+y chord opens real Quick Open.
Negative command removes the default F2 rename binding while the custom F7 binding opens the actual rename editor.
Invalid saved JSON reports a warning, preserves its bytes for correction, and keeps the last working custom shortcuts active.
Valid shortcuts persist in the own profile and activate again after real Reload Window.

Harness now matches complete .label-name text; prior failures remain. Widget attachment/activation additionally follows awaited standard shell lifecycle.
remaining: Workspace-scoped keymap editing and full overlapping When-expression conflict analysis; ordinary same-key conflicts are shown without claiming DSL overlap analysis.
Broader extension/language and original stock JSON automatic diagnostic compatibility; C++ LLDB launch.
